name: Homerarete Nobiru SR Shoujo-tachi 2
storyline:
The protagonist successfully helped the previous game's heroines grow. Having gotten together with all the heroines, he thought he could finally relax... Only for yet another job to come his way.

Indeed - four SR girls had come to St. Marianne Girls' Academy, where the protagonist works. And this time too, the SR girls each have their own quirks.

A doujin artist whose works end up becoming "Special-Class Cursed Objects."
A witch who always seems to cause some kind of trouble.
A girl who can't bring herself to like her best feature.
A girl who has awakened to memories of her past life.

And just like the heroines before them, they don't understand who they truly are...

And so, the job of "helping SR girls grow" begins once again.
